muyesser-irab:1-1.t: ﴿طه﴾: the discussion of the disjointed letters (al-ḥurūf al-muqaṭṭaʿa) has already been given at the beginning of Sūrat al-Baqara.

muyesser-irab:2-2.t: ﴿ما أنزلنا عليك القرآن لتشقى﴾: (ما) is negating; (أنزلنا) is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); (عليك) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أنزلنا﴾; (القرآن) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿لتشقى﴾: the lām is for causation (taʿlīl), and (تشقى) is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muḍmara) an after the lām; the interpreted maṣdar formed from ﴿أن﴾ and the verb is genitive (majrūr) by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿أنزلنا﴾.

muyesser-irab:3-3.t: ﴿إلا تذكرة لمن يخشى﴾: (إلا) is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); (تذكرة) is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose) [Translator's note: the source has the misprint «لأجه» for «لأجله»]; the exception is disconnected (munqaṭiʿ); it is also said: (تذكرة) is a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of a ḥāl (circumstantial).

muyesser-irab:4-4.t:
﴿تنزيلا﴾: a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of a verb that is obligatorily omitted, its implied form being "We sent it down a sending-down" (نزلناه تنزيلًا); it is also said: a badal (substitute) from (تذكرة) if that is taken as a ḥāl (circumstantial); it is also said: accusative on account of praise and specialisation (al-madḥ wa-l-ikhtiṣāṣ); and it is also said: made accusative by ﴿يخشى﴾ as its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), i.e.: Allah sent it down as a reminder for whoever fears the sending-down of Allah.
﴿ممن﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تنزيلًا﴾.
﴿خلق الأرض﴾: a past verb, the fāʿil (agent) being latent (mustatir), and a mafʿūl bihi.
﴿والسماوات﴾: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ﴿الأرض﴾, accusative (manṣūb). The clause (خلق الأرض والسماوات) is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿من﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿العلا﴾: a naʿt (adjective).

muyesser-irab:5-5.t: ﴿الرحمن على العرش استوى﴾: (الرحمن) is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "He" (هو), or it is a mubtadaʾ; (على العرش) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) (استوى); and the clause (استوى) is a second khabar of the implied ﴿هو﴾, or the khabar of (الرحمن).

muyesser-irab:6-6.t: ﴿له ما في السماوات وما في الأرض وما بينهما وما تحت الثرى﴾: (له) is a fronted khabar (predicate), and (ما) is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿في السماوات﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted [word] that is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position; ﴿ما في الأرض﴾ is conjoined to (ما في السماوات); (ما بينهما) is likewise conjoined; (ما) is conjoined to (ما); and (تحت الثرى) is an adverb attached to an omitted [word] that is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:7-7.t: ﴿وإن تجهر بالقول فإنه يعلم السر وأخفى﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; (إن) is conditional; (تجهر) is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); (بالقول) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تجهر﴾; (فإنه): the fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa) because the apodosis (jawāb) is a nominal clause; (إن) is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle, and the hāʾ is a pronoun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the accusative as the noun of inna; the clause (يعلم السر) is the khabar (predicate) of inna; and (أخفى) is an elative noun (ism tafḍīl) conjoined to (السر), i.e.: "more hidden than it"; it is also said: it is a past verb, i.e.: and Allah has hidden His unseen from His servants.

muyesser-irab:8-8.t:
﴿الله﴾: a mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿لا﴾: the lā of generic negation.
﴿إله﴾: its noun (ism), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa in the position of the accusative.
﴿إلا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr).
﴿هو﴾: a badal (substitute) from the position of (لا) and its noun, because their position is nominative as a mubtadaʾ; or a badal from the pronoun latent in the omitted khabar (predicate). The clause ﴿لا إله إلا هو﴾ is the khabar.
﴿له الأسماء الحسنى﴾: ﴿له﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted [word] that is a fronted khabar; (الأسماء) is a postponed mubtadaʾ; (الحسنى) is a naʿt (adjective) of (الأسماء); and the clause is a second khabar.

muyesser-irab:9-9.t: ﴿وهل أتاك حديث موسى﴾: the wāw is for resumption, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; (أتاك) is a verb and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (حديث موسى) is the fāʿil (agent); and the interrogation is for affirmation (taqrīr).

muyesser-irab:10-10.t:
﴿إذ رأى نارا فقال لأهله امكثوا إني آنست نارا﴾: ﴿إذ﴾ is an adverb of past time attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿حديث﴾ in the preceding ayah; the clause ﴿رأى﴾ is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (نارًا) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (فقال) is conjoined to (رأى); (لأهله) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (قال); the clause (امكثوا) is the content of the speech (maqūl al-qawl); the clause (إني) gives the reason for the command to stay; (إن) is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle, and the yāʾ is a pronoun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the accusative as the noun of inna; the clause (آنست) is the khabar (predicate) of inna; and (نارًا) is a mafʿūl bihi.
﴿لعلي آتيكم منها بقبس أو أجد على النار هدى﴾: (لعل) is an abrogating particle, and the yāʾ is a pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of the accusative as the noun of laʿalla; the clause (آتيكم) is the khabar of laʿalla; (منها) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), because it was originally an adjective of (القبس); ﴿أو﴾ is a conjunction; (أجد) is conjoined to (آتيكم), and the fāʿil (agent) of (أجد) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "I" (أنا); (على النار) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿أجد﴾; and (هدى) is a mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:11-11.t: ﴿فلما أتاها نودي يا موسى﴾: the fāʾ conjoins to something omitted, the implied sense being: "so he headed towards the fire"; (لما) is temporal (ẓarfiyya ḥīniyya), or connective (rābiṭa); (أتاها) is a verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause (نودي) has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis (jawāb) of a non-jussive condition; and (يا موسى) is a vocative particle and the one addressed.

muyesser-irab:12-12.t: ﴿إني أنا ربك فاخلع نعليك إنك بالواد المقدس طوى﴾: (إن) is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle, and the yāʾ is a pronoun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the accusative as the noun of inna; (أنا) is a tawkīd (emphasis) of the pronoun, or a mubtadaʾ (subject); (ربك) is the khabar (predicate) of inna, accusative [Translator's note: so in the source («منصوب»); the khabar of inna is nominative (marfūʿ)], and the kāf is a pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); or it is the khabar of (أنا), and the clause is the khabar of inna; the first is preferable; (فاخلع): the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ implying an omitted condition), and (اخلع) is an imperative verb with a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent); (نعليك) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause (إنك) gives the reason for the removing; (إن) is an abrogating particle, and the kāf is a pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of the accusative as the noun of inna; (بالوادي) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar of inna; (المقدس) is a naʿt (adjective); and (طوى) is a badal (substitute) or ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition).

muyesser-irab:13-13.t: ﴿وأنا اخترتك فاستمع لما يوحى﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (أنا) is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause (اخترتك), made up of the verb, the fāʿil (agent) and the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), is the khabar (predicate); (فاستمع): the fāʾ is a conjunction, and (استمع) is an imperative verb, the fāʿil being latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); (لما) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) (استمع); the clause (يوحى) is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; and (يوحى) is in the passive form (built for that whose agent is not named).

muyesser-irab:14-14.t: ﴿إنني أنا الله لا إله إلا أنا فاعبدني وأقم الصلاة لذكري﴾: the clause is a badal (substitute) from ﴿ما﴾ in ﴿لما يوحى﴾; (إن) is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle, and the yāʾ is a pronoun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the accusative as the noun of inna; (أنا) is a tawkīd (emphasis) of the pronoun, or a mubtadaʾ (subject); (الله) is the khabar (predicate) of inna, or the khabar of (أنا), the clause then being the khabar of inna; the clause ﴿لا إله إلا أنا﴾ is a second khabar; (فاعبدني): the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ implying an omitted condition), and (اعبدني) is an imperative verb with a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent), the nūn being for protection (al-wiqāya) and the yāʾ the object; (أقم الصلاة) is conjoined to (اعبدني); (لذكرى) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أقم﴾, and it is a maṣdar (verbal noun) annexed to its object, i.e.: "so that you remember Me in it"; it is also said: the maṣdar is annexed to its agent, i.e.: "for My remembering you".

muyesser-irab:15-15.t: ﴿إن الساعة آتية أكاد أخفيها لتجزى كل نفس بما تسعى﴾: (إن) is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle; (الساعة) is the noun of inna, accusative (manṣūb); (آتية) is the khabar (predicate) of inna, nominative (marfūʿ); (أكاد) is a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, one of the verbs of approximation (afʿāl al-muqāraba), and its noun (ism) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "I" (أنا); the clause ﴿أخفيها﴾ is the khabar of (أكاد); (لتجزى): the lām is for causation (taʿlīl), and (تجزى) is an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied (muḍmara) an; the interpreted maṣdar from an and the verb is genitive (majrūr) by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أخفيها﴾ or to ﴿آتية﴾; the clause ﴿أكاد أخفيها﴾ is parenthetical between them, with no grammatical position; it is also said that the clause ﴿أكاد أخفيها﴾ is in the position of the nominative as a second khabar of ﴿إن﴾; and it is also said that it is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from ﴿الساعة﴾. (كل) is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and (نفس) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (بما) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿تجزى﴾; the clause (تسعى) is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; and it is also said: (ما) is maṣdar-forming (maṣdariyya), i.e.: "with the recompense of its striving", on the assumption of an omitted muḍāf.

muyesser-irab:16-16.t: ﴿فلا يصدنك عنها من لا يؤمن بها واتبع هواه فتردى﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ implying an omitted condition); (لا) is prohibitive; (يصدنك) is an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is joined to the nūn of emphasis, and it is in the position of the jussive by the prohibitive (لا); the kāf is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (عنها) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يصدنك﴾; (مَن) is the fāʿil (agent); the clause (لا يؤمن) is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿من﴾, with no grammatical position; ﴿بها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يؤمن﴾; (اتبع هواه) is a verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi; (فتردى): the fāʾ is the fāʾ of causation (al-sababiyya), and (تردى) is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muḍmara) an after the fāʾ, with a fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif; the interpreted maṣdar from an and the verb is conjoined to a maṣdar extracted from the preceding speech, i.e.: "let there be no turning away, and so a perishing".

muyesser-irab:17-17.t: ﴿وما تلك بيمينك يا موسى﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (ما) is an interrogative noun for affirmation (taqrīr), a mubtadaʾ (subject), and (تلك) is its khabar (predicate); ﴿بيمينك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), resembling the statement of Allah the Exalted: ﴿وهذا بعلي شيخا﴾, and what governs the implied ḥāl is the demonstrative; and (يا موسى) is a vocative.

muyesser-irab:18-18.t:
﴿قال هي عصاي أتوكأ عليها وأهش بها على غنمي﴾: (هي) is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and (عصاي) is its khabar (predicate); the clause (أتوكأ عليها) is a ḥāl (circumstantial) clause, and it is also said: resumptive, with no grammatical position; (أهش بها على غنمي) is conjoined to (أتوكأ عليها); ﴿بها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أهش﴾, and likewise (على غنمي).
﴿ولي فيها مآرب أخرى﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (لي) is a fronted khabar; (فيها) is a ḥāl; (مآرب) is a postponed mubtadaʾ; and (أخرى) is a naʿt (adjective) of (مآرب).

muyesser-irab:19-19.t: ﴿قال ألقها يا موسى﴾: the clause (ألقها) is the content of the speech (maqūl al-qawl), and (يا موسى) is a vocative.

muyesser-irab:20-20.t: ﴿فألقاها فإذا هي حية تسعى﴾: (ألقاها) is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the fāʾ is a conjunction; (إذا) is for surprise (al-mufājaʾa); ﴿هي﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and (حية) is the khabar (predicate); and the clause (تسعى) is a ḥāl (circumstantial), or a second khabar.

muyesser-irab:21-21.t: ﴿قال خذها ولا تخف سنعيدها سيرتها الأولى﴾: the clause (خذها) is the content of the speech (maqūl al-qawl); the wāw is a conjunction; (لا) is prohibitive; (تخف) is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive (لا); the sīn is a particle of the future; (نعيدها) is an imperfect verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "we" (نحن); (سيرتها) is accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e.: "to its state"; it is also said: it is an adverb; it is also said: a badal (substitute) of inclusion (badal ishtimāl) from the object pronoun; and it is also said: it is made accusative by an implied verb, i.e.: "it will go its first way"; and (الأولى) is a naʿt (adjective).

muyesser-irab:22-22.t: ﴿واضمم يدك إلى جناحك تخرج بيضاء من غير سوء آية أخرى﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (اضمم) is conjoined to (ألقها); (يدك) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); (إلى جناحك) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) (اضمم); (تخرج) is jussive (majzūm) as the answer to the request (jawāb al-ṭalab); (بيضاء) is a ḥāl (circumstantial); (من غير سوء) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (بيضاء), because of the verbal meaning it contains, or attached to ﴿تخرج﴾; (آية) is a second ḥāl, also from the fāʿil of (تخرج); it is also said: it is made accusative by an implied [verb], such as "take" (خذ) or "here you have" (دونك); and (أخرى) is a naʿt (adjective) of (آية).

muyesser-irab:23-23.t: ﴿لنريك من آياتنا الكبرى﴾: the lām is for causation (taʿlīl); (نريك) is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muḍmara) an after the lām, and it gives the reason for an omitted [verb] to which it is attached, i.e.: "We commanded you with what We mentioned in order to show you by it", i.e. by your hand; the interpreted maṣdar from an and the verb is genitive (majrūr) by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted verb, its implied form being "We made it" (جعلناها); ﴿من آياتنا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted [word], as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from ﴿الكبرى﴾, ﴿الكبرى﴾ on this view being the second object of ﴿نريك﴾; or, more correctly, it is a naʿt (adjective) of the second object, the implied sense being: "to show you the greatest sign from among Our signs", i.e. while it is one of Our signs.

muyesser-irab:24-24.t: ﴿اذهب إلى فرعون إنه طغى﴾: (اذهب) is an imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); (إلى فرعون) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) (اذهب); (إن) is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle, the hāʾ is its noun (ism), and the clause (طغى) is its khabar (predicate); and the clause (إنه طغى) is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:25-25.t: ﴿قال رب اشرح لي صدري﴾: (قال) is a past verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he" (هو); (رب) is a vocative (munādā) annexed to the omitted yāʾ of the first person; (اشرح) is a verb of supplication; (لي) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿اشرح﴾; and (صدري) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

muyesser-irab:26-26.t: ﴿ويسر لي أمري﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (يسِّر) is a verb of supplication, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); (أمري) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

muyesser-irab:27-27.t: ﴿واحلل عقدة من لساني﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (احلل) is a verb of supplication, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); (عقدة) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and (من لساني) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of (عقدة), as though it were said: "a knot from among the knots of my tongue".

muyesser-irab:28-28.t: ﴿يفقهوا قولي﴾: (يفقهوا) is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) as the answer to the request (jawāb al-ṭalab); the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); and (قولي) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

muyesser-irab:29-29.t: ﴿واجعل لي وزيرا من أهلي﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (اجعل) is a verb of supplication, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); (لي) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted second object; (وزيرًا) is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and (من أهلي) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of ﴿وزيرًا﴾.

muyesser-irab:30-30.t: ﴿هارون أخي﴾: (هارون) is a badal (substitute) from ﴿وزيرًا﴾, and (أخي) is a badal from (هارون); or (وزيرًا) is the second object and (هارون) the first object, (لي) being a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), or to the very act of making, and (من أهلي) a naʿt (adjective); or ﴿وزيرًا﴾ is the first object and (من أهلي) is the second.

muyesser-irab:31-31.t: ﴿اشدد به أزري﴾: (اشدد) is a verb of supplication, and its fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "you" (أنت); ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿اشدد﴾; and (أزري) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

muyesser-irab:32-32.t: ﴿وأشركه في أمري﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (أشركه) is conjoined to (اشدد), and the hāʾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and (في أمري) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أشركه﴾.

muyesser-irab:33-33.t: ﴿كي نسبحك كثيرا﴾: (كي) is a particle that forms a maṣdar, makes [the verb] accusative and denotes the future; (نسبحك) is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by ﴿كي﴾, and the fāʿil (agent) of (نسبحك) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "we" (نحن); and (كثيرًا) is an adjective of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), so it stands in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e.: "that we glorify You with much glorification", or an adjective of an omitted adverb of time, i.e.: "that we glorify You for much time".

muyesser-irab:34-34.t: ﴿ونذكرك كثيرا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (نذكرك) is an imperfect verb conjoined to (نسبحك), accusative (manṣūb), and the fāʿil (agent) of (نذكرك) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "we" (نحن); and (كثيرًا) is an adjective of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), so it stands in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e.: "that we remember You with much remembrance", or an adjective of an omitted adverb of time, i.e.: "that we remember You for much time".

muyesser-irab:35-35.t: ﴿إنك كنت بنا بصيرا﴾: (إن) is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle, and the kāf is its noun (ism); the clause (كنت) is the khabar (predicate) of inna; the tāʾ is the noun of kāna; (بنا) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿بصيرًا﴾; and (بصيرًا) is the khabar of kāna, accusative (manṣūb).

muyesser-irab:36-36.t: ﴿قال قد أوتيت سؤلك يا موسى﴾: the clause (قد أوتيت) is the content of the speech (maqūl al-qawl); (أوتيت) is a past verb in the passive (built for that whose agent is not named); the tāʾ is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); and (سؤلك) is the second mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of (أوتيت).

muyesser-irab:37-37.t: ﴿ولقد مننا عليك مرة أخرى﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; the lām is the answer to the omitted oath; (قد) is a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq); (مننا) is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); (عليك) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿مننا﴾; ﴿مرة﴾ is an adverb, or it stands in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is its number; and (أخرى) is a naʿt (adjective) of (مرة).

muyesser-irab:38-38.t: ﴿إذ أوحينا إلى أمك ما يوحى﴾: ﴿إذ﴾ is an adverb of past time attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿مننا﴾; the clause ﴿أوحينا﴾ is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (إلى أمك) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿أوحينا﴾; ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdar-forming (maṣdariyya), interpreted together with what follows it as a maṣdar that is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), or it is a relative [noun] and so a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the clause ﴿يوحى﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:39-39.t:
﴿أن اقذفيه في التابوت﴾: (أن) is explicative (tafsīriyya), and the clause after it is explicative, with no grammatical position. (اقذفيه) is an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and (في التابوت) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) (اقذفيه).
﴿فاقذفيه في اليم﴾: conjoined to ﴿اقذفيه في التابوت﴾.
﴿فليلقه اليم بالساحل﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; the lām is the lām of command; (يلقه) is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the lām of command, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the weak letter; the hāʾ is a mafʿūl bihi; (اليم) is the fāʿil; this is a command whose meaning is a statement; and (بالساحل) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يلقه﴾, or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e.: "being in contact with it".
﴿يأخذه عدو لي وعدو له﴾: (يأخذه) is the answer to the request (jawāb al-ṭalab); the hāʾ is the object; (عدو) is the fāʿil; (لي) is a naʿt (adjective); and ﴿وعدو له﴾ is conjoined to ﴿عدو لي﴾.
﴿وألقيت عليك محبة مني ولتصنع على عيني﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (ألقيت) is a verb and its fāʿil; (عليك) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿ألقيت﴾; (محبة) is a mafʿūl bihi; (مني) is a naʿt of (محبة), or attached to ﴿ألقيت﴾; (ولتصنع) is conjoined to something omitted, i.e.: "so that people would love you"; (ولتصنع): the lām is for causation (taʿlīl), and (تصنع) is an imperfect verb in the passive (built for that whose agent is not named), accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muḍmara) an after the lām; the interpreted maṣdar from an and the verb is genitive (majrūr) by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an implied [verb], its implied form being: "and so that you would be made, I did that"; and ﴿على عيني﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl.

muyesser-irab:40-40.t:
﴿إذ تمشي أختك فتقول هل أدلكم على من يكفله﴾: ﴿إذ﴾ is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿ألقيت﴾ or to ﴿تصنع﴾; the clause ﴿تمشي﴾ is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (أختك) is the fāʿil (agent); (فتقول) is conjoined to (تمشي); (هل) is a particle of interrogation; (أدلكم) is an imperfect verb, and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "I" (أنا), and the kāf is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿على من﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿أدلكم﴾; and the clause (يكفله) is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿من﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿فرجعناك إلى أمك كي تقر عينها ولا تحزن﴾: the fāʾ conjoins to something omitted, its implied form being: "and her request was granted"; (رجعناك) is a verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; ﴿إلى أمك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿رجعناك﴾; (كي) is a particle that makes [the verb] accusative; (تَقَر) is accusative (manṣūb) by ﴿كي﴾; (عينها) is the fāʿil; and (ولا تحزن) is conjoined to ﴿كي تقر﴾.
﴿وقتلت نفسا فنجيناك من الغم وفتناك فتونا﴾: the wāw is resumptive; (قتلت) is a verb and its fāʿil; (نفسًا) is the object of (قتل); the clause ﴿وقتلت نفسا﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position; (فنجيناك): the fāʾ is a conjunction, and (نجيناك) is a verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; (من الغم) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿نجيناك﴾; (فتناك) is a verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; and (فتونًا) is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object).
﴿فلبثت سنين في أهل مدين ثم جئت على قدر يا موسى﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; (لبثت) is a verb and its fāʿil; (سنين) is an adverb of time attached to ﴿لبثت﴾; (في أهل مدين) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿لبثت﴾; (مدين) is muḍāf ilayhi, a diptote because it is a proper name and feminine; (ثم) is a conjunction; (جئت) is a verb and its fāʿil; and (على قدر) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).

muyesser-irab:41-41.t: ﴿واصطنعتك لنفسي﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and (لنفسي) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb.

muyesser-irab:42-42.t: ﴿اذهب أنت وأخوك بآياتي ولا تنيا في ذكري﴾: (اذهب) is an imperative verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); (أنت) is a detached pronoun, a tawkīd (emphasis) of the latent pronoun; (أخوك) is conjoined to the nominative pronoun, the sign of its nominative being the wāw, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (بآياتي): the bāʾ is for accompaniment, and (بآياتي) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e.: "accompanied by My signs"; the wāw is a conjunction; (لا) is prohibitive; (تنيا) is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive (لا), and the alif is the fāʿil; (في ذكري) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿تنيا﴾, and ﴿في﴾ is in its literal sense of containment (ẓarfiyya); it is also said: ﴿في﴾ here means "from" (عن), i.e.: "from My worship".

muyesser-irab:43-43.t: ﴿اذهبا إلى فرعون إنه طغى﴾: (اذهبا) is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); (إلى فرعون) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿اذهبا﴾; (إن) is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle, the hāʾ is its noun (ism), and the clause (طغى) is its khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:44-44.t: ﴿فقولا له قولا لينا لعله يتذكر أو يخشى﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; (قولا) is an imperative verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿له﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿قولا﴾; (قولًا) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), or a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative (manṣūb) with the fatḥa. (لينًا) is a naʿt (adjective); (لعل) is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle, the hāʾ is its noun (ism), and the clause (يتذكر) is its khabar (predicate); (أو) is a conjunction; and (يخشى) is conjoined to (يتذكر).

muyesser-irab:45-45.t: ﴿قالا ربنا إننا نخاف أن يفرط علينا أو أن يطغى﴾: (قالا) is a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); (ربنا) is a vocative (munādā) in a genitive construct; (إن) is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle, and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun (ism); the clause (نخاف) is the khabar (predicate) of inna; (أن) together with what falls within its scope is the object of (نخاف); (علينا) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يفرط﴾; (أو) is a conjunction; and ﴿أن يطغى﴾ is conjoined to ﴿أن يفرط﴾.

muyesser-irab:46-46.t: ﴿قال لا تخافا إنني معكما أسمع وأرى﴾: (لا) is prohibitive; (تخافا) is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by (لا), and the alif is the fāʿil (agent); the clause (لا تخافا) is the content of the speech (maqūl al-qawl); the clause (إنني معكما) is causal (taʿlīliyya); (إن) is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle, the yāʾ is its noun (ism), and the adverb is attached to (mutaʿalliq) its omitted khabar (predicate); the clause (أسمع) is a second khabar, or a ḥāl (circumstantial) clause; and (أرى) is conjoined to (أسمع).

muyesser-irab:47-47.t:
﴿فأتياه فقولا إنا رسولا ربك﴾: (فأتياه): the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ implying an omitted condition), and (أتياه) is an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (فقولا) is conjoined to (فأتياه); (إن) is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle, ﴿نا﴾ is its noun (ism), (رسولا) is its khabar (predicate), and (ربك) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿فأرسل معنا بني إسرائيل ولا تعذبهم﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa; (أرسل) is an imperative verb, and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); (معنا) is an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أرسل﴾; (بني إسرائيل) is a mafʿūl bihi; (ولا تعذبهم): (لا) is prohibitive, (تعذبهم) is jussive (majzūm) by (لا), and the hāʾ is a mafʿūl bihi.
﴿قد جئناك بآية من ربك﴾: (قد) is a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq); (جئناك) is a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; (بآية) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿جئناك﴾; (من ربك) is a naʿt (adjective) of (آية); and the clause ﴿قد جئناك...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿والسلام على من اتبع الهدى﴾: the wāw is resumptive; (السلام) is a mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿على من اتبع الهدى﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted khabar; and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:48-48.t: ﴿إنا قد أوحي إلينا أن العذاب على من كذب وتولى﴾: (إن) is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle, and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun (ism); the clause (قد أوحي) is its khabar (predicate); (إلينا) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أوحي﴾; (أن) together with what falls within its scope is interpreted as a maṣdar that is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of ﴿أوحي﴾; (أن) is an abrogating particle, and (العذاب) is the noun of anna; ﴿على من﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar of anna; the clause (كذب) is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿من﴾, with no grammatical position; and (تولى) is conjoined to (كذب).

muyesser-irab:49-49.t: ﴿قال فمن ربكما يا موسى﴾: the fāʾ conjoins to something implied, i.e.: "so they came to him and said all that was mentioned"; ﴿مَن﴾ is an interrogative noun, a mubtadaʾ (subject), and (ربكما) is the khabar (predicate); and the clause is the content of the speech (maqūl al-qawl).

muyesser-irab:50-50.t: ﴿قال ربنا الذي أعطى كل شيء خلقه ثم هدى﴾: (ربنا) is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and (الذي) is its khabar (predicate); the clause (أعطى) is the ṣila (relative clause) of (الذي), with no grammatical position; (كل شيء) is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and (خلقه) is the second mafʿūl bihi; it is also said: (خلقه) is the first of the two objects of (أعطى) and (كل شيء) the second; and (ثم هدى) is conjoined to (أعطى).

muyesser-irab:51-51.t: ﴿قال فما بال القرون الأولى﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; (ما) is interrogative, a mubtadaʾ (subject); (بال) is the khabar (predicate); (القرون) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and (الأولى) is a naʿt (adjective).

muyesser-irab:52-52.t: ﴿قال علمها عند ربي في كتاب لا يضل ربي ولا ينسى﴾: (علمها) is a mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿عند ربي﴾: the adverb is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate); ﴿في كتاب﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); or it is attached to the omitted khabar, and ﴿عند ربي﴾ is an adverb attached to an omitted ḥāl; or both are attached to two omitted [words] that are two khabars; or both are attached to a single omitted khabar; the clause (لا يضل) is resumptive, with no grammatical position; it is also said: it is a naʿt (adjective) of (كتاب), the referring pronoun being omitted, its implied form being: "in a book which my Lord does not lose", or: "whose preservation my Lord does not lose"; (ربي) is the fāʿil (agent) of (يضل); and (ولا ينسى) is conjoined to (لا يضل).

muyesser-irab:53-53.t:
﴿الذي جعل لكم الأرض مهدا وسلك لكم فيها سبلا﴾: (الذي) is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e.: "He" (هو); the clause (جعل) is the ṣila (relative clause) of (الذي), with no grammatical position; ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), because it was an adjective of ﴿مهدًا﴾ and was then placed before it; (الأرض) is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and (مهدًا) the second mafʿūl bihi; (سلك) is a past verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he" (هو); ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl, because it was an adjective of ﴿سبلًا﴾; (فيها) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿سلك﴾; and (سبلًا) is a mafʿūl bihi.
﴿وأنزل من السماء ماء فأخرجنا به أزواجا من نبات شتى﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (أنزل) is conjoined to what precedes; (من السماء) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿أنزل﴾; (ماء) is a mafʿūl bihi; (فأخرجنا): the fāʾ is a conjunction, and (أخرجنا) is a verb and its fāʿil; ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿أخرجنا﴾; (أزواجًا) is a mafʿūl bihi; (من نبات) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of ﴿أزواجًا﴾; and (شتى) is a naʿt of ﴿أزواجًا﴾, or a ḥāl from it, because it [the noun] has been described; it is also said: it is a naʿt of (النبات).

muyesser-irab:54-54.t: ﴿كلوا وارعوا أنعامكم إن في ذلك لآيات لأولي النهى﴾: (كلوا) is an imperative verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause is governed by an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e.: "saying"; (ارعوا) is conjoined to (كلوا); (أنعامكم) is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of (ارعوا); (إن) is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle; (في ذلك) is the fronted khabar (predicate) of inna; (لآيات): the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and (آيات) is the postponed noun of inna; (لأولي النهى) is a naʿt (adjective) of (آيات); and (النهى) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

muyesser-irab:55-55.t: ﴿منها خلقناكم وفيها نعيدكم ومنها نخرجكم تارة أخرى﴾: (منها) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿خلقناكم﴾; (فيها) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿نعيدكم﴾; (منها) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿نخرجكم﴾; (تارة) is an adverb attached to ﴿نخرجكم﴾; and (أخرى) is a naʿt (adjective) of (تارة).

muyesser-irab:56-56.t: ﴿ولقد أريناه آياتنا كلها فكذب وأبى﴾: the lām is the answer to an omitted oath; (قد) is a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq); (أريناه) is a past verb, (نا) being an attached pronoun in the position of the nominative as fāʿil (agent), and the hāʾ the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (آياتنا) is the second mafʿūl bihi; (كلها) is a tawkīd (emphasis) of (آياتنا); and (فكذب وأبى) is conjoined to (أريناه).

muyesser-irab:57-57.t: ﴿قال أجئتنا لتخرجنا من أرضنا بسحرك يا موسى﴾: (قال) is a past verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he" (هو), i.e. Pharaoh; the clause (أجئتنا) is the content of the speech (maqūl al-qawl); the hamza is for disapproving interrogation (al-istifhām al-inkārī); (جئتنا) is a verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (لتخرجنا): the lām is for causation (taʿlīl), and (تخرج) is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muḍmara) an after the lām of causation, and (نا) is a mafʿūl bihi; the interpreted maṣdar from an and the verb is genitive (majrūr) by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) (جئتنا); ﴿من أرضنا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿تخرجنا﴾; and ﴿بسحرك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿تخرجنا﴾.

muyesser-irab:58-58.t: ﴿فلنأتينك بسحر مثله فاجعل بيننا وبينك موعدا لا نخلفه نحن ولا أنت مكانا سوى﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ implying an omitted condition); the lām is the answer to an omitted oath, its implied form being: "By Allah, we shall surely bring you"; (بسحر) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿نأتينك﴾, or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); (مثله) is a naʿt (adjective) of (سحر); (فاجعل): the fāʾ is a conjunction, and (اجعل) is an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) being "you" (أنت); (بيننا) is an adverb attached to an omitted [word] that is the second mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (بينك) is conjoined [Translator's note: the source has «معطف», evidently for «معطوف»]; (موعدًا) is a mīm-maṣdar (maṣdar mīmī), the first mafʿūl bihi; the clause (لا نخلفه) is a naʿt of ﴿موعدًا﴾; (نحن) is a tawkīd (emphasis) of the pronoun in (نخلفه); the wāw is a conjunction, (لا) is negating, and (أنت) is conjoined to the pronoun in (نخلفه); (مكانًا) is a badal (substitute) from ﴿موعدًا﴾ on the assumption of a muḍāf ilayhi, i.e.: "the place of the appointment"; or it is accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e.: "in a place"; or it is made accusative by the maṣdar, namely (موعد). (سوى) is a naʿt, i.e.: "in the middle".

muyesser-irab:59-59.t: ﴿قال موعدكم يوم الزينة وأن يحشر الناس ضحى﴾: (موعدكم) is a mubtadaʾ (subject); (يوم الزينة): the adverb is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate); (أن) together with what follows it is conjoined to (يوم الزينة): either to (اليوم), so that the position of the maṣdar is nominative, or to (الزينة), so that its position is genitive; (الناس) is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); and (ضحى) is an adverb attached to ﴿يحشر﴾.

muyesser-irab:60-60.t: ﴿فتولى فرعون فجمع كيده ثم أتى﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; (تولى) is a past verb, and (فرعون) is the fāʿil (agent); (فجمع) is conjoined to (فتولى); (كيده) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), on the assumption of an omitted muḍāf, i.e.: "the agents of his scheme", namely the sorcerers; (ثم) is a conjunction; and (أتى) is conjoined to (جمع).

muyesser-irab:61-61.t:
﴿قال لهم موسى ويلكم لا تفتروا على الله كذبا﴾: (قال) is a past verb; ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) it; (موسى) is the fāʿil (agent); (ويلكم) is the object of an omitted verb, by way of deterrence, i.e.: "may Allah make woe cling to you"; (لا) is prohibitive; (تفتروا) is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by (لا); (على الله) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿تفتروا﴾; and ﴿كذبا﴾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the verb ﴿لا تفتروا﴾, i.e.: "do not fabricate a lie", or a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e.: "do not invent for the sake of lying".
﴿فيسحتكم بعذاب وقد خاب من افترى﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ of causation (al-sababiyya); ﴿يسحتكم﴾ is an imperfect [verb], accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muḍmara) an; the interpreted maṣdar from an and the verb is conjoined to a maṣdar extracted from the preceding speech, i.e.: "let there be no fabrication, and so an annihilation". ﴿بعذاب﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يسحتكم﴾; ﴿وقد﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and (قد) is a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq); ﴿خاب﴾ is a past verb; ﴿مَن﴾ is the fāʿil; and the clause (افترى) is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿من﴾, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:62-62.t: ﴿فتنازعوا أمرهم بينهم وأسروا النجوى﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; (تنازعوا) is a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma because it is joined to the wāw of the plural, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (أمرهم) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), or accusative by removal of the preposition; (بينهم) is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); (أسروا) is conjoined to (تنازعوا); and (النجوى) is a mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:63-63.t: ﴿قالوا إن هذان لساحران يريدان أن يخرجاكم من أرضكم بسحرهما ويذهبا بطريقتكم المثلى﴾: (إن) is lightened from the heavy [inna] (mukhaffafa min al-thaqīla), and its noun (ism) is the omitted pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn); (هذان) is a demonstrative for the dual, in the position of the nominative as a mubtadaʾ (subject); the lām is the distinguishing lām (al-lām al-fāriqa); (ساحران) is the khabar (predicate) of ﴿هذان﴾; the clause (يريدان) is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿ساحران﴾; (أن) together with what falls within its scope is the object of (يريدان); (من أرضكم) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يخرجاكم﴾; (بسحرهما) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e.: "engaged in their sorcery"; (يذهبا) is conjoined to (يخرجاكم); (بطريقتكم) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يذهبا﴾; (المثلى) is a naʿt of (طريقتكم); and the clause ﴿هذان...﴾ is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of the lightened (إن).

muyesser-irab:64-64.t:
﴿فأجمعوا كيدكم ثم ائتوا صفا﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ implying an omitted condition); (أجمعوا) is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (كيدكم) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) if ﴿أجمعوا﴾ is taken as transitive, or accusative by removal of the preposition if it is taken as intransitive; ﴿ثم ائتوا﴾ is conjoined to ﴿أجمعوا﴾; and (صفًّا) is a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e.: "come lined up"; it is also said: it is a mafʿūl bihi, i.e.: "come, a people in a row".
﴿وقد أفلح اليوم من استعلى﴾: the wāw is parenthetical or resumptive. (قد) is a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq). (أفلح) is a past verb. (اليوم) is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أفلح﴾. (من) is the fāʿil of (أفلح). The clause ﴿استعلى﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿من﴾, with no grammatical position. The clause ﴿وقد أفلح...﴾ is parenthetical or resumptive, and on either view it has no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:65-65.t: ﴿قالوا يا موسى إما أن تلقي وإما أن نكون أول من ألقى﴾: (إما) is a particle of condition and detailing (tafṣīl); (أن) together with what follows it is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun), accusative by an omitted verb, its implied form being: "choose one of the two things"; or nominative as the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being: "the matter is your throwing"; or a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is omitted, the implied sense being: "your throwing is first"; ﴿وإما أن نكون﴾ is conjoined to what precedes; the noun (ism) of (نكون) is a hidden pronoun, its implied form being "we" (نحن), and (أول) is its khabar; (من) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and the clause (ألقى) is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿من﴾, with no grammatical position. Or (أن) together with what falls within its scope is in the position of the accusative by an implied verb, i.e.: "choose your throwing first, or our throwing".

muyesser-irab:66-66.t: ﴿قال بل ألقوا فإذا حبالهم وعصيهم يخيل إليه من سحرهم أنها تسعى﴾: (بل) is a particle of digression (iḍrāb) and conjunction; (ألقوا) is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (فإذا): the fāʾ conjoins to something omitted, its implied form being "so they threw", and (إذا) is for surprise (al-mufājaʾa), the clause being initial (ibtidāʾiyya); (حبالهم) is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and (عصيهم) is conjoined to it; the clause (يخيل إليه) is the khabar (predicate) of (حبالهم); (من سحرهم) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يخيل﴾; (أنها): (أن) is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle, the hāʾ is its noun (ism), and the clause (تسعى) is the khabar of anna; and (أن) together with what follows it is interpreted as a maṣdar that is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of (يخيل), i.e.: "their moving was made to seem to him".

muyesser-irab:67-67.t: ﴿فأوجس في نفسه خيفة موسى﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; (أوجس) is a past verb; (في نفسه) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أوجس﴾; (خيفة) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and (موسى) is the fāʿil (agent).

muyesser-irab:68-68.t: ﴿قلنا لا تخف إنك أنت الأعلى﴾: (قلنا) is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause (لا تخف) is the content of the speech (maqūl al-qawl); (لا) is prohibitive; (تخف) is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive (لا), and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); the clause ﴿إنك...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position; (إن) is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle, and the kāf is its noun (ism); (أنت) is a tawkīd (emphasis), or a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl), or a mubtadaʾ (subject); and (الأعلى) is the khabar (predicate) of inna, or the khabar of (أنت), the clause then being the khabar of inna.

muyesser-irab:69-69.t:
﴿وألق ما في يمينك تلقف ما صنعوا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (وألق): the wāw is a conjunction, and (ألق) is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the weak letter, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); (ما) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (في يمينك) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted [word] that is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position; (تلقف) is the answer to the request (jawāb al-ṭalab), jussive (majzūm), the sign of its jussive being the sukūn; the fāʿil of (تلقف) is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "it" (هي); (ما) is a mafʿūl bihi; and the clause (صنعوا) is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿إنما صنعوا كيد ساحر ولا يفلح الساحر حيث أتى﴾: [this gives] the reason for His statement (تلقف); (إن) is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle; (ما) is a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the accusative as the noun of inna; the clause (صنعوا) is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; (كيد ساحر) is the khabar (predicate) of inna; (ما) is either relative, or indefinite-described (mawṣūfa), or maṣdar-forming (maṣdariyya), i.e.: "that which they made", or "something they made", or "their making", and the i'rab is the same; (ولا): the wāw is a conjunction, and (لا) is negating; (يفلح الساحر) is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; (حيث) is an adverb of place, indeclinable on the ḍamma, attached to ﴿يفلح﴾; and the clause (أتى) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

muyesser-irab:70-70.t: ﴿فألقي السحرة سجدا قالوا آمنا برب هارون وموسى﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; (ألقي) is a past verb in the passive (built for that whose agent is not named); (السحرة) is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); (سجدًا) is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from (السحرة); (قالوا) is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause (آمنا) is the content of the speech (maqūl al-qawl), and it is a verb and its fāʿil; ﴿برب﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿آمنا﴾; ﴿هارون﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and (موسى) is conjoined (maʿṭūf), genitive (majrūr).

muyesser-irab:71-71.t:
﴿قال آمنتم له قبل أن آذن لكم﴾: the clause (آمنتم) is the content of the speech (maqūl al-qawl); (آمنتم): the hamza is for interrogation, reprimand and rebuke; the first hamza was dropped and the second softened; it is a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿له﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿آمنتم﴾; ﴿قبل﴾ is an adverb also attached to ﴿آمنتم﴾; and the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿أن آذن لكم﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿إنه لكبيركم الذي علمكم السحر﴾: (إن) is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle, and the hāʾ is its noun (ism); the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); (كبيرهم) is its khabar (predicate) [Translator's note: so in the source; the Quranic word is (كبيركم)]; (الذي) is a naʿt (adjective); the clause ﴿علمكم السحر﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of (الذي), with no grammatical position; and (السحر) is the second mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of (علمكم).
﴿فلأقطعن أيديكم وأرجلكم من خلاف﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ implying an omitted condition); the lām occurs in the answer to the oath; (أقطعن) is an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis, and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "I" (أنا); (أيديكم) is a mafʿūl bihi; (أرجلكم) is conjoined to (أيديكم); (من خلاف) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) meaning "alternate"; and (مِن) is a particle for the beginning of the spatial extent (ibtidāʾ al-ghāya al-makāniyya).
﴿ولأصلبنكم في جذوع النخل﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (لأصلبنكم) is conjoined to (لأقطعن); (في) is for containment (ẓarfiyya), and the adverbial phrase is attached to ﴿أصلبنكم﴾.
﴿ولتعلمن أينا أشد عذابا وأبقى﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (لتعلمن) is conjoined to (لأصلبنكم); ﴿أينا﴾ is interrogative, a mubtadaʾ (subject), and (أشد) is the khabar; the clause is in the position of the accusative, standing in place of the two objects of (تعلمن); or (أي) is relative, and it is the mafʿūl bihi of (تعلمن), the first part of its ṣila having been omitted, (أشد) being the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "he" (هو), and the clause (أشد) is the ṣila of the relative, with no grammatical position; and (أبقى) is conjoined to (أشد).

muyesser-irab:72-72.t:
﴿قالوا لن نؤثرك على ما جاءنا من البينات والذي فطرنا﴾: (لن) is a particle of negation, accusative and future; (نؤثرك) is an imperfect [verb], accusative (manṣūb) by (لن); the kāf is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "we" (نحن); the clause is the content of their speech (maqūl al-qawl); ﴿على ما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿نؤثرك﴾; the clause (جاءنا) is the ṣila (relative clause); (من البينات) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); (الذي) is conjoined to (ما); or the wāw is for the oath, and (الذي) is genitive by the wāw of the oath, i.e.: the one sworn by, namely Allah the Exalted, (فطرنا) being the ṣila, and the preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted verb, its implied form being "I swear"; the answer to the oath is then omitted, its implied form being: "we shall not prefer you over the truth that has come to us".
﴿فاقض ما أنت قاض إنما تقضي هذه الحياة الدنيا﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ implying an omitted condition); (اقض) is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the weak letter, and its fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "you" (أنت); (ما) is a mafʿūl bihi; (أنت) is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and (قاض) is the khabar (predicate), nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) because of heaviness on the yāʾ that was elided because of the meeting of two vowelless letters; the clause (أنت قاض) is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position, and the referring pronoun is omitted, i.e.: "decreeing it"; (إنما) is the restraining (kāffa) and restrained (makfūfa) particle; (تقضي) is an imperfect verb, and the fāʿil is latent, its implied form being "you" (أنت); the object of (تقضي) is omitted, its implied form being "your aim"; (هذه) is an adverb, (الحياة) a badal (substitute) and (الدنيا) a naʿt (adjective), and the adverb is attached to ﴿تقضي﴾; it is also said: (ما) is relative or maṣdar-forming and is the noun of inna, the khabar being the adverb; or (هذه الحياة الدنيا) is a mafʿūl bihi by extension (ʿalā al-saʿa).

muyesser-irab:73-73.t: ﴿إنا آمنا بربنا ليغفر لنا خطايانا وما أكرهتنا عليه من السحر والله خير وأبقى﴾: (إن) is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle, and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun (ism); the clause (آمنا) is its khabar (predicate); (بربنا) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿آمنا﴾; the lām is for causation (taʿlīl), and (يغفر) is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muḍmara) an after the lām of causation; the interpreted maṣdar from an and the verb is genitive (majrūr) by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (آمنا); ﴿لنا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يغفر﴾; (ما) is conjoined to (خطايانا); it is also said: the wāw is initial (ibtidāʾiyya) and (ما) is a mubtadaʾ (subject), the clause (أكرهتنا) being the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position, and the khabar being omitted, i.e.: "is lifted from us"; ﴿عليه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿أكرهتنا﴾; (من السحر) is a ḥāl (circumstantial); (الله) is a mubtadaʾ, (خير) is the khabar, and (أبقى) is conjoined to (خير).

muyesser-irab:74-74.t: ﴿إنه من يأت ربه مجرما فإن له جهنم لا يموت فيها ولا يحيا﴾: (إن) is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle, and the hāʾ is its noun (ism); ﴿مَن﴾ is a conditional noun that makes [the verb] jussive, in the position of the nominative as a mubtadaʾ (subject); (يأت) is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the weak letter, and the fāʿil (agent) of (يأت) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he" (هو); (ربه) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (مجرمًا) is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil of (يأت); (فإن): the fāʾ connects (rābiṭa) the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and (إن) is an abrogating particle; ﴿له﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate) of inna; (جهنم) is its postponed noun; the clause (لا يموت فيها) is a ḥāl from the hāʾ in (له) or from (جهنم); (فيها) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يموت﴾; and (ولا يحيا) is conjoined to (لا يموت).

muyesser-irab:75-75.t: ﴿ومن يأته مؤمنا قد عمل الصالحات فأولئك لهم الدرجات العلا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿مَن﴾ is a conditional noun that makes [the verb] jussive, in the position of the nominative as a mubtadaʾ (subject); (يأت) is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the weak letter, and the fāʿil (agent) of (يأت) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he" (هو); the hāʾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (مؤمنًا) is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil of (يأت); the clause ﴿قد عمل الصالحات﴾ is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿مؤمنًا﴾; (فأولئك): the fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa), and (أولئك) is a demonstrative, a mubtadaʾ; ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate); (الدرجات) is a postponed mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause is the khabar of (أولئك); the clause (فأولئك) is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the protasis and its apodosis are the khabar of (من); and (العلى) is a naʿt of (الدرجات).

muyesser-irab:76-76.t: ﴿جنات عدن تجري من تحتها الأنهار خالدين فيها وذلك جزاء من تزكى﴾: (جنات عدن) is a badal (substitute) from (الدرجات العلى), or the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause (تجري من تحتها الأنهار) is a naʿt (adjective) of (جنات); (خالدين فيها) is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from ﴿من﴾; (فيها) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) (خالدين); (ذلك) is a mubtadaʾ, and (جزاء) is the khabar; (من) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and the clause (تزكى) is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿من﴾, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:77-77.t:
﴿ولقد أوحينا إلى موسى أن أسر بعبادي﴾: the wāw is a conjunction or resumptive; the lām is the answer to the omitted oath, and (قد) is a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq). (أوحينا) is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and (إلى موسى) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أوحينا﴾. ﴿أن﴾ is explicative (tafsīriyya), because revelation contains the meaning of speech without its letters, and the clause after it is explicative, with no grammatical position. Or ﴿أن﴾ is maṣdar-forming (maṣdariyya), and together with what it introduces it is interpreted as a maṣdar, accusative by removal of the preposition, the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to ﴿أوحى﴾; and the clause ﴿أسر﴾ is the ṣila of the maṣdar-forming ﴿أن﴾, with no grammatical position. (أسر) is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the weak letter, and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir). (بعبادي) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿أسر﴾. The clause ﴿ولقد أوحينا...﴾ is conjoined, or resumptive with no grammatical position.
﴿فاضرب لهم طريقا في البحر يبسا لا تخاف دركا ولا تخشى﴾: (فاضرب) is conjoined to (أسر), i.e.: "make"; ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿اضرب﴾, standing in place of the second object; (طريقًا) is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (في البحر) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective); (يبسًا) is a second naʿt, and it describes what it will become, or it is a maṣdar (verbal noun) used as a description for intensification; the clause (لا تخاف) is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil of (اضرب), i.e.: "strike, not fearing", or a naʿt of ﴿طريقًا﴾, the referring pronoun being omitted, i.e.: "in which you will not fear", or it is a resumptive clause with no grammatical position; (لا) is negating; (تخاف) is an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ), and its fāʿil is "you" (أنت); (دركًا) is a mafʿūl bihi; and the clause (ولا تخشى) is conjoined to (لا تخاف).

muyesser-irab:78-78.t: ﴿فأتبعهم فرعون بجنوده فغشيهم من اليم ما غشيهم﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; (أتبعهم) is a past verb that takes two objects, the second of which is omitted, the implied sense being: "so Pharaoh made his punishment follow them", the hāʾ being the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); it is also said: the bāʾ is connective (ṣila) [i.e. redundant] in the second object, the implied sense being: "so Pharaoh made his soldiers follow them"; and it is also said: it has the meaning of (تبع) and takes one object; ﴿بجنوده﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); (فغشيهم): the fāʾ is a conjunction, (غشيهم) is a past verb, the hāʾ is the object, and (ما) is the fāʿil (agent); and the clause (غشيهم) is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:79-79.t: ﴿وأضل فرعون قومه وما هدى﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (أضل) is a past verb; (فرعون) is the fāʿil (agent); (قومه) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the clause (وما هدى) is conjoined to (أضل).

muyesser-irab:80-80.t:
﴿يا بني إسرائيل قد أنجيناكم من عدوكم﴾: (يا) is a vocative particle, and (بني إسرائيل) is a vocative (munādā) in a genitive construct; (قد) is a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq); (أنجيناكم) is a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and (من عدوكم) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أنجيناكم﴾.
﴿وواعدناكم جانب الطور الأيمن ونزلنا عليكم المن والسلوى﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (واعدناكم) is conjoined to (أنجيناكم); (واعدناكم) is a verb, its fāʿil and its first mafʿūl bihi; (جانب الطور) is the second mafʿūl bihi, on the assumption of an omitted muḍāf, i.e.: "coming to the side"; (الأيمن) is a naʿt (adjective) of (جانب); (نزلنا) is conjoined to what precedes it; ﴿عليكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿نزلنا﴾; (المن) is a mafʿūl bihi; and (السلوى) is conjoined to (المن).

muyesser-irab:81-81.t:
﴿كلوا من طيبات ما رزقناكم ولا تطغوا فيه فيحل عليكم غضبي﴾: (كلوا) is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (من طيبات) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿كلوا﴾; (ما) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause (رزقناكم) is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; (ولا تطغوا): the wāw is a conjunction, (لا) is prohibitive, and (تطغوا) is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive (لا), the wāw being the fāʿil; (فيه) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿تطغوا﴾; (فيحل): the fāʾ is of causation (al-sababiyya), and ﴿يحل﴾ is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muḍmara) an; the interpreted maṣdar from an and the verb is conjoined to a maṣdar extracted from the preceding speech, i.e.: "let there be no transgression, and so a descent of My wrath". ﴿عليكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يحل﴾; (غضبي) is the fāʿil; and it is also said: it is conjoined.
﴿ومن يحلل عليه غضبي فقد هوى﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (من) is conditional, a mubtadaʾ (subject); (يحلل) is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); ﴿عليه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يحلل﴾; (غضبي) is the fāʿil of (يحلل); the fāʾ connects (rābiṭa) the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (قد) is a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq); (هوى) is a past verb, i.e.: "he perished"; the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis; and the protasis and its apodosis are the khabar (predicate) of (مَن).

muyesser-irab:82-82.t: ﴿وإني لغفار لمن تاب وآمن وعمل صالحا ثم اهتدى﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (إن) is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle, and the yāʾ is a pronoun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the accusative as the noun of inna; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); (غفار) is the khabar (predicate) of inna, nominative (marfūʿ); (لمن) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) (غفار); the clause (تاب) is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿من﴾, with no grammatical position; (آمن) and (عمل) are conjoined; (صالحًا) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿عمل﴾, or it stands in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is an adjective of the maṣdar, i.e.: "he did a righteous deed"; and (ثم اهتدى) is conjoined.

muyesser-irab:83-83.t: ﴿وما أعجلك عن قومك يا موسى﴾: (ما) is an interrogative noun, a mubtadaʾ (subject); (أعجل) is a past verb with a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent), its implied form being "it" (هو), referring back to (ما); the kāf is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the khabar (predicate) of (ما); and (عن قومك) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أعجلك﴾.

muyesser-irab:84-84.t: ﴿قال هم أولاء على أثري وعجلت إليك رب لترضى﴾: ﴿هم﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and (أولاء) is the khabar (predicate); (على أثري) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted second khabar, or a ḥāl (circumstantial); (عجلت) is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), with (قد) implied, or a conjunction; (إليك) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿عجلت﴾; (رب) is a vocative (munādā) annexed to the omitted yāʾ of the first person, the vocative particle being omitted; and (لترضى): the lām is for causation (taʿlīl), and (ترضى) is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muḍmara) an after the lām of causation; the interpreted maṣdar from an and the verb is genitive (majrūr) by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are also attached to ﴿عجلت﴾.

muyesser-irab:85-85.t: ﴿قال فإنا قد فتنا قومك من بعدك وأضلهم السامري﴾: (قال) is a past verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), referring back to Allah; the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ implying an omitted condition); (إن) is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle, and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun (ism); the clause (قد فتنا) is its khabar (predicate), and it is a verb and its fāʿil; (قومك) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and (أضلهم السامري) is a verb, a fronted mafʿūl bihi and a postponed fāʿil.

muyesser-irab:86-86.t:
﴿فرجع موسى إلى قومه غضبان أسفا﴾: the fāʾ is for immediate sequence (taʿqīb); (رجع) is a past verb, and (موسى) is the fāʿil (agent); (إلى قومه) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿رجع﴾; and (غضبان) and (أسفًا) are two ḥāls (circumstantials).
﴿قال يا قوم ألم يعدكم ربكم وعدا حسنا﴾: (يا) is a vocative particle, and (قوم) is a vocative (munādā) annexed to the omitted yāʾ of the first person; (ألم): the hamza is for interrogation; (يعدكم) is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by (لم); the kāf is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (ربكم) is the fāʿil; (وعدًا) is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); and (حسنًا) is a naʿt (adjective).
﴿أفطال عليكم العهد أم أردتم أن يحل عليكم غضب من ربكم فأخلفتم موعدي﴾: the hamza is for interrogation, and the fāʾ is a conjunction joining to something omitted; (طال) is a past verb; ﴿عليكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿طال﴾; (العهد) is the fāʿil; (أم) is a conjunction counterbalancing the hamza; (أردتم) is a verb and its fāʿil; (أن) together with what falls within its scope is the object of (أردتم); ﴿عليكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يحل﴾; (غضب) is the fāʿil of (يحل); (من ربكم) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt of (غضب); (فأخلفتم): the fāʾ is a conjunction, and (أخلفتم) is conjoined to (أردتم); and (موعدي) is the object of (أخلفتم).

muyesser-irab:87-87.t:
﴿قالوا ما أخلفنا موعدك بملكنا﴾: (قالوا) is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); (ما) is negating; (أخلفنا) is a verb and its fāʿil; (موعدك) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and (بملكنا) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted [word], a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) [Translator's note: the source repeats the phrase «متعلقان بمحذوف جار ومجرور» here, evidently by mistake; the intended analysis is: attached to an omitted ḥāl], i.e.: "while we were in control of our affair".
﴿ولكنا حملنا أوزارا من زينة القوم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (لكن) is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle, and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun (ism); (حملنا) is a past verb in the passive (built for that whose agent is not named), and ﴿نا﴾ is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); (أوزارًا) is the second mafʿūl bihi; ﴿من زينة القوم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective); and the clause ﴿حملنا﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of lākinna.
﴿فقذفناها فكذلك ألقى السامري﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; (قذفناها) is a verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi, and it is conjoined to something omitted; (فكذلك): the fāʾ is a conjunction; ﴿كذلك﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like", indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as an adjective of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun); ﴿ذلك﴾: ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the lām is for distance, and the kāf is a particle of address; and (ألقى السامري) is a verb and its fāʿil.

muyesser-irab:88-88.t:
﴿فأخرج لهم عجلا جسدا له خوار﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; (أخرج) is a past verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he" (هو), referring back to al-Sāmirī, the conjunction being to (فأضلهم السامري); ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أخرج﴾; (عجلًا) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿جسدًا﴾ admits three analyses: first, that it is a naʿt (adjective); second, that it is a ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition); third, that it is a badal (substitute), and this is the preferred view; ﴿له﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate); (خوار) is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); and the clause made up of the mubtadaʾ and khabar is a naʿt of ﴿عجلا﴾.
﴿فقالوا هذا إلهكم وإله موسى فنسي﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; (قالوا) is a verb and its fāʿil; (هذا) is a mubtadaʾ; ﴿إلهكم﴾ is the khabar; ﴿إله موسى﴾ is conjoined to (إلهكم); (فنسي): the fāʾ is a conjunction, and (نسي) is a past verb, and its fāʿil is latent, its implied form being "he" (هو), referring back to Moses; it is also said: the pronoun refers back to al-Sāmirī.

muyesser-irab:89-89.t: ﴿أفلا يرون ألا يرجع إليهم قولا ولا يملك لهم ضرا ولا نفعا﴾: the hamza is for interrogation, the fāʾ is a conjunction, and (لا) is negating; (يرون) is an imperfect verb [nominative] by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (أن) is lightened from the heavy [anna] (mukhaffafa min al-thaqīla), and its noun (ism) is the omitted pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn), i.e.: "that it [is the case]"; (لا) is negating; (يرجع) is an imperfect verb, and the fāʿil of (يرجع) is a hidden pronoun, its implied form being "it" (هو), referring back to the calf; ﴿إليهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يرجع﴾; (قولًا) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the verbal clause is in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the lightened (أن); the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿ألا يرجع﴾ stands in place of the two objects of ﴿يرى﴾; and the clause ﴿أفلا يرون﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is resumptive.

muyesser-irab:90-90.t:
﴿ولقد قال لهم هارون من قبل﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; the lām occurs in the answer to the oath; (قد) is a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq); ﴿قال لهم هارون﴾ is a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); and (من قبل) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿يا قوم إنما فتنتم به وإن ربكم الرحمن فاتبعوني وأطيعوا أمري﴾: (يا) is a vocative particle, and (قوم) is a vocative (munādā) annexed to the omitted yāʾ of the first person; (إنما) is the restraining (kāffa) and restrained (makfūfa) particle; (فتنتم) is a past verb in the passive (built for that whose agent is not named), the tāʾ being the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) and the mīm the sign of the masculine plural; ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿فتنتم﴾; ﴿إن ربكم الرحمن﴾: (إن) is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle, (ربكم) is its noun (ism), accusative (manṣūb), and (الرحمن) is its khabar (predicate), nominative (marfūʿ); the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ implying an omitted condition); (اتبعوني) is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, the wāw being the fāʿil, the nūn for protection (al-wiqāya) and the yāʾ the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and (أطيعوا أمري) is conjoined to (اتبعوني).

muyesser-irab:91-91.t: ﴿قالوا لن نبرح عليه عاكفين حتى يرجع إلينا موسى﴾: (لن) is a particle of negation, accusative and future; (نبرح) is a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by ﴿لن﴾, and its noun (ism) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "we" (نحن); (عليه) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) (عاكفين); (عاكفين) is the khabar (predicate) of (نبرح); (حتى) is a particle of limit and of the genitive; (يرجع) is an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied (muḍmara) an after (حتى); the interpreted maṣdar from an and the verb is genitive (majrūr) by (حتى), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿عاكفين﴾; and ﴿إلينا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يرجع﴾.

muyesser-irab:92-92.t: ﴿قال يا هارون ما منعك إذ رأيتهم ضلوا﴾: (ما) is an interrogative noun in the position of the nominative as a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause (منعك) is the khabar (predicate); (إذ) is an adverb of past time attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿منعك﴾; the clause ﴿رأيتهم﴾ is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (رأيتهم) is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the clause (ضلوا) is a ḥāl (circumstantial) clause, or a second mafʿūl bihi of (رأيتهم) if it is taken as a verb of the heart (qalbiyya).

muyesser-irab:93-93.t: ﴿ألا تتبعن أفعصيت أمري﴾: ﴿ألّا﴾: (أن) is a maṣdar-forming particle that makes [the verb] accusative, and (لا) is a connective (ṣila) particle; ﴿تتبعن﴾ is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by (أن), the nūn being for protection (al-wiqāya) and the omitted yāʾ of the first person the object; the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿ألّا تتبعن﴾ is the second object of ﴿منع﴾ in the previous ayah; ﴿أفعصيت﴾: the hamza is for interrogation, and the fāʾ conjoins to something implied; (عصيت) is a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); and ﴿أمري﴾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

muyesser-irab:94-94.t:
﴿قال يا ابن أم لا تأخذ بلحيتي ولا برأسي﴾: (يا ابن أم): (يا) is a vocative particle, and (ابن) is a vocative (munādā) in a genitive construct, accusative (manṣūb); (أم) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive with a kasra implied (muqaddar) on the letter before the alif that was elided for lightness, and the elided alif, converted from the yāʾ, is muḍāf ilayhi; it is also said: they are two indeclinable (mabnī) nouns because they have been compounded in the way numbers and adverbs are compounded; (لا) is prohibitive; (تأخذ) is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive (لا), and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); (بلحيتي) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تأخذ﴾; and (ولا برأسي) is conjoined to (بلحيتي).
﴿إني خشيت أن تقول فرقت بين بني إسرائيل ولم ترقب قولي﴾: (إن) is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle, and the yāʾ is a pronoun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the accusative as the noun of inna; the clause (خشيت) is the khabar (predicate) of inna; (أن) together with what falls within its scope is the object of (خشيت); the clause (فرقت) is the content of the speech (maqūl al-qawl); (بين) is an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿فرقت﴾; (بني إسرائيل) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (ولم ترقب قولي) is conjoined to (فرقت), the pronoun in (قولي) then referring to Moses; or it is conjoined to (خشيت), the pronoun in (قولي) then referring to Aaron.

muyesser-irab:95-95.t: ﴿قال فما خطبك يا سامري﴾: (قال) is a past verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he" (هو), referring back to Moses; the fāʾ is a conjunction or resumptive; (ما) is interrogative, a mubtadaʾ (subject), and (خطبك) is the khabar (predicate); (يا) is a vocative particle, and (سامري) is a vocative (munādā), a single proper noun; and the clause ﴿فما خطبك يا سامري﴾ is conjoined to the content of the speech (maqūl al-qawl), or resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:96-96.t:
﴿قال بصرت بما لم يبصروا به فقبضت قبضة من أثر الرسول﴾: the clause (بصرت) is the content of the speech (maqūl al-qawl), and the fāʿil (agent) of (قال) is "he", i.e. al-Sāmirī; (بما) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿بصرت﴾; the clause (لم يبصروا به) is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; (فقبضت) is conjoined to (بصرت); (قبضة) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿من أثر﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of (قبضة); (أثر) is muḍāf, and (الرسول) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), on the assumption of two omitted words, i.e.: "from the trace of the hoof of the Messenger's horse".
﴿فنبذتها وكذلك سولت لي نفسي﴾: (فنبذتها) is conjoined to (قبضت); (وكذلك): the kāf is a noun meaning "like", indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as an adjective of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e.: "with the like of that enticement my soul enticed me"; ﴿ذلك﴾: ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi, the lām is for distance, and the kāf is a particle of address; and (سولت لي نفسي) is a verb and its fāʿil.

muyesser-irab:97-97.t:
﴿قال فاذهب فإن لك في الحياة أن تقول لا مساس﴾: (قال) is a past verb, and its fāʿil (agent) refers back to Moses; (فاذهب): the fāʾ is a conjunction, and (اذهب) is an imperative verb whose fāʿil is "you" (أنت); (فإن): the fāʾ is a conjunction, and (إن) is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle; ﴿لك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate) of inna; (في الحياة) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); (أن) together with what follows it is the noun of inna; (لا) is the lā of generic negation; (مساس) is the noun of (لا); and the khabar is omitted.
﴿وإن لك موعدا لن تخلفه﴾: (إن) is an abrogating particle; ﴿لك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted, fronted khabar of inna; (موعدًا) is its postponed noun; (لن) is a particle of negation, accusative and future; (تخلفه) is accusative (manṣūb) by (لن); the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); and the hāʾ is the second mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿وانظر إلى إلهك الذي ظلت عليه عاكفا لنحرقنه ثم لننسفنه في اليم نسفا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (انظر) is an imperative verb, and its fāʿil is latent, its implied form being "you" (أنت); (إلى إلهك) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿انظر﴾; (الذي) is a naʿt (adjective); the clause (ظلت) is the ṣila (relative clause) of (الذي), with no grammatical position; (ظلت) is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb; (عليه) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿عاكفًا﴾; (عاكفًا) is the khabar of (ظلت); (لنحرقنه): the lām occurs in the answer to the oath, and (نحرقنه) is an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is joined to the nūn of emphasis, the fāʿil being latent, its implied form being "we" (نحن), and the hāʾ a mafʿūl bihi; (ثم) is a conjunction; (لننسفنه): the lām occurs in the answer to the oath, and (ننسفنه) is an imperfect verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa because it is joined to the nūn of emphasis; (في اليم) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿ننسفنه﴾; and (نسفًا) is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object).

muyesser-irab:98-98.t:
﴿إنما إلهكم الله الذي﴾: (إنما) is the restraining (kāffa) and restrained (makfūfa) particle; (إلهكم) is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and (الله) is its khabar (predicate); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; and (الذي) is a naʿt (adjective).
﴿لا﴾: the lā of generic negation.
﴿إله﴾: its noun (ism), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa in the position of the accusative.
﴿إلا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr).
﴿هو﴾: a badal (substitute) from the position of (لا) and its noun, because their position is nominative as a mubtadaʾ; or a badal from the pronoun latent in the omitted khabar. The clause (لا إله إلا هو) is the ṣila (relative clause) of (الذي), with no grammatical position.
﴿وسع كل شيء علما﴾: (وسع) is a past verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he" (هو); (كل شيء) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct) [Translator's note: so in the source; (كل) is in fact the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of (وسع), and (شيء) is the muḍāf ilayhi]; and (علمًا) is a tamyīz (specification) converted from the fāʿil of (وسع).

muyesser-irab:99-99.t: ﴿كذلك نقص عليك من أنباء ما قد سبق وقد آتيناك من لدنا ذكرا﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like", indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as an adjective of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun) of ﴿نقص﴾, i.e.: "We relate to you a relating like that relating"; ﴿ذلك﴾: ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the lām is for distance, and the kāf is a particle of address; (نقص) is an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "we" (نحن); ﴿عليك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿نقص﴾; (من أنباء) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of (نقص); (ما) is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause ﴿قد سبق﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; ﴿وقد﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and (قد) is a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq); ﴿آتيناك﴾ is a past verb, ﴿نا﴾ being the fāʿil and the kāf a mafʿūl bihi; ﴿من لدنا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), because it was an adjective of ﴿ذكرًا﴾; and (ذكرًا) is the second mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:100-100.t: ﴿من أعرض عنه فإنه يحمل يوم القيامة وزرا﴾: (من) is conditional, in the position of the nominative as a mubtadaʾ (subject); (أعرض) is a past verb in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and its fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "he" (هو); (عنه) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أعرض﴾; the fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa); (إن) is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle, the hāʾ is its noun (ism), and the clause (يحمل) is its khabar (predicate), the fāʿil being latent, its implied form being "he" (هو); (يوم القيامة) is an adverb attached to ﴿يحمل﴾; (وزرًا) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the clause (من أعرض) is in the position of the accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿ذكرًا﴾.
