muyesser-irab:101-101.t: ﴿خالدين فيه وساء لهم يوم القيامة حملا﴾: (خالدين) is a ḥāl (circumstantial); (فيه) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) (خالدين), and the pronoun refers back to the burden (الوزر); (وساء): the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya) or a conjunction, and (ساء) is a past verb, one of the verbs of blame, its fāʿil (agent) being latent (mustatir) and specified by an indefinite, namely ﴿حملًا﴾, while the one specifically blamed (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-dhamm) is omitted, its implied form being "their burden"; ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an implied verb of saying, i.e.: "these words are said to them"; it is also said: it is like the lām in ﴿هيت لك﴾, i.e. for mere clarification; (يوم القيامة) is an adverb attached to ﴿ساء﴾; and (حملًا) is a tamyīz (specification).

muyesser-irab:102-102.t: ﴿يوم ينفخ في الصور ونحشر المجرمين يومئذ زرقا﴾: ﴿يوم﴾ is an adverb, a badal (substitute) from (يوم القيامة); the clause (ينفخ) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (ينفخ) is an imperfect verb in the passive (built for that whose agent is not named); ﴿في الصور﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿ينفخ﴾; ﴿نحشر﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and ﴿نحشر﴾ is an imperfect verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "we" (نحن); (المجرمين) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿يومئذ﴾: (يوم) is an adverb attached to ﴿نحشر﴾, and (إذٍ) is a noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on a sukūn implied (muqaddar) because the slot is occupied by the tanwīn of compensation, in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi, the tanwīn compensating for an omitted clause, the implied sense being: "and We gather the criminals on the day when the trumpet is blown"; and (زرقًا) is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from (المجرمين).

muyesser-irab:103-103.t: ﴿يتخافتون بينهم إن لبثتم إلا عشرا﴾: the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from (المجرمين), or resumptive with no grammatical position; (يتخافتون) is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, because it is one of the five verbs, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (بينهم) is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يتخافتون﴾; (إن لبثتم) is a clause in the accusative by a verb of saying indicated by (يتخافتون), the saying being accusative as a ḥāl, i.e.: "saying in secret"; (إن) is negating; (لبثتم) is a verb and its fāʿil; (إلا) is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); and (عشرًا) is an adverb of time.

muyesser-irab:104-104.t: ﴿نحن أعلم بما يقولون إذ يقول أمثلهم طريقة إن لبثتم إلا يوما﴾: (نحن) is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and (أعلم) is the khabar (predicate); (بما) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أعلم); the clause (يقولون) is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; (إذ) is an adverb attached to ﴿أعلم﴾; the clause ﴿يقول﴾ is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (أمثلهم) is the fāʿil (agent); (طريقة) is a tamyīz (specification); (إن) is negating; (لبثتم) is a verb and its fāʿil; (إلا) is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); and (يومًا) is an adverb attached to ﴿لبثتم﴾.

muyesser-irab:105-105.t: ﴿ويسألونك عن الجبال فقل ينسفها ربي نسفا﴾: the wāw is for resumption; (يسألونك) is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, the wāw being the fāʿil (agent) and the kāf a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿عن الجبال﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يسألونك﴾; the clause ﴿ويسألونك عن الجبال﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position; ﴿فقل﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and (قل) is an imperative verb, and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); the clause (ينسفها) is the content of the speech (maqūl al-qawl); ﴿ها﴾ is a fronted mafʿūl bihi; (ربي) is a postponed fāʿil; and (نسفًا) is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object).

muyesser-irab:106-106.t: ﴿فيذرها قاعا صفصفا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; (يذرها) is an imperfect verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he" (هو), i.e. Allah the Exalted; ﴿ها﴾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (قاعًا) is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the accusative pronoun, or a second mafʿūl bihi, because (يذر) is made to include the meaning of "turning into" (al-taṣyīr); and (صفصفًا) is a second ḥāl, or a badal (substitute) from the second object; it is also said: it is a naʿt (adjective) of it.

muyesser-irab:107-107.t: ﴿لا ترى فيها عوجا ولا أمتا﴾: the clause is a third ḥāl (circumstantial), or a first ḥāl; (لا) is negating; (ترى) is an imperfect verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); (فيها) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿ترى﴾; (عوجًا) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and (ولا أمتًا) is conjoined.

muyesser-irab:108-108.t:
﴿يومئذ يتبعون الداعي لا عوج له﴾: ﴿يومئذ﴾: (يوم) is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يتبعون﴾, or a badal (substitute) from the earlier ﴿يوم القيامة﴾; (إذٍ) is a noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on a sukūn implied (muqaddar) because the slot is occupied by the tanwīn of compensation, in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the tanwīn compensating for an omitted clause; ﴿يتبعون الداعي﴾ is an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (لا) is the lā of generic negation; (عوج) is its noun (ism), indeclinable on the fatḥa; ﴿له﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of (لا); and the clause ﴿لا عوج له﴾ is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from (الداعي), or an adjective of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e.: "they follow him with a following that has no crookedness", or resumptive with no grammatical position.
﴿وخشعت الأصوات للرحمن فلا تسمع إلا همسا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (خشعت الأصوات) is a verb and its fāʿil; ﴿للرحمن﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿خشعت﴾; the fāʾ is a conjunction; (لا) is negating; (تسمع) is an imperfect verb, and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he" (هو) [Translator's note: so in the source; with the second-person (تسمع) one would expect "you" (أنت)]; (إلا) is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); and (همسًا) is a mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:109-109.t: ﴿يومئذ لا تنفع الشفاعة إلا من أذن له الرحمن ورضي له قولا﴾: ﴿يومئذ﴾: (يوم) is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) the negated verb ﴿تنفع﴾; (إذٍ) is a noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on a sukūn implied (muqaddar) because the slot is occupied by the tanwīn of compensation, in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the tanwīn compensating for an omitted clause; (لا) is negating; (تنفع الشفاعة) is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent); (إلا) is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); (من) is the object of ﴿تنفع﴾; the clause ﴿أذن له الرحمن﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿من﴾, with no grammatical position; ﴿رضي له قولًا﴾ is conjoined to (أذن له); and it is also said: the accusative is as an object.

muyesser-irab:110-110.t: ﴿يعلم ما بين أيديهم وما خلفهم ولا يحيطون به علما﴾: (يعلم) is an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ), and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he" (هو); (ما) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (بين) is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted [word] that is the ṣila of the relative, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position; (أيديهم) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause ﴿يعلم ما...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position; ﴿ما خلفهم﴾ is conjoined to ﴿ما بين أيديهم﴾; (ولا يحيطون): the wāw is a conjunction or circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and (يحيطون) is an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يحيطون﴾; and (علمًا) is a mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:111-111.t: ﴿وعنت الوجوه للحي القيوم وقد خاب من حمل ظلما﴾: the wāw is resumptive; (عنت الوجوه) is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿وعنت الوجوه﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position; (للحي) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿عنت﴾; (القيوم) is a naʿt (adjective); the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and the clause (وقد خاب) is a ḥāl (circumstantial) clause; (من) is the fāʿil of (خاب); and the clause (حمل ظلمًا) is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿من﴾, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:112-112.t: ﴿ومن يعمل من الصالحات وهو مؤمن فلا يخاف ظلما ولا هضما﴾: the wāw conjoins to (وقد خاب); (من) is conditional, a mubtadaʾ (subject); (يعمل) is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); (من الصالحات) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of an omitted mafʿūl bihi (direct object), i.e.: "deeds"; the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); ﴿هو﴾ is a mubtadaʾ, and (مؤمن) is the khabar (predicate); the fāʾ connects (rābiṭa) the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (لا) is negating; (يخاف) is an imperfect verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he" (هو); (ظلمًا) is a mafʿūl bihi; (ولا هضمًا) is conjoined to ﴿ظلمًا﴾; the clause (لا يخاف) is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, the implied sense being: "then he does not fear"; the clause (فهو لا يخاف) is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis; and the protasis and its apodosis are the khabar of (من).

muyesser-irab:113-113.t:
﴿وكذلك أنزلناه قرآنا عربيا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿كذلك﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like", indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as an adjective of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun) of ﴿أنزلناه﴾, i.e.: "with the like of that sending-down We sent it down"; ﴿ذلك﴾: ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the lām is for distance, and the kāf is a particle of address; ﴿أنزلناه﴾ is a past verb, ﴿نا﴾ being the fāʿil (agent) and the hāʾ a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿قرآنًا﴾ is a ḥāl (circumstantial); and ﴿عربيًّا﴾ is a naʿt (adjective).
﴿وصرفنا فيه من الوعيد لعلهم يتقون أو يحدث لهم ذكرا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿صرفنا﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil; ﴿فيه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿صرفنا﴾; ﴿من الوعيد﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt of an omitted object, i.e.: "We varied a threat from among the threats"; (لعل) is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle expressing hope, ﴿هم﴾ is its noun (ism), and the clause (يتقون) is its khabar (predicate); (أو) is a conjunction; (يحدث) is conjoined to (يتقون); ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يحدث﴾; (ذكرًا) is a mafʿūl bihi; and the fāʿil of (يحدث) is "it", i.e. the Quran.

muyesser-irab:114-114.t: ﴿فتعالى الله الملك الحق ولا تعجل بالقرآن من قبل أن يقضى إليك وحيه وقل رب زدني علما﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; ﴿تعالى الله﴾ is a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿الملك الحق﴾ are two adjectives of (الله); the clause ﴿فتعالى الله﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position; (ولا تعجل): the wāw is a conjunction, (لا) is prohibitive, and (تعجل) is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive (لا); (بالقرآن) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تعجل﴾; ﴿من قبل﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿تعجل﴾; the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿أن يقضى﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); ﴿إليك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يقضى﴾; (يقضى) is an imperfect verb in the passive (built for that whose agent is not named), and (وحيه) is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); (قل) is conjoined to (لا تعجل); (رب) is a vocative (munādā) annexed to the omitted yāʾ of the first person; (زدني) is a verb of supplication, the nūn being for protection (al-wiqāya) and the yāʾ the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and (علمًا) is the second mafʿūl bihi, or a tamyīz (specification).

muyesser-irab:115-115.t: ﴿ولقد عهدنا إلى آدم من قبل فنسي ولم نجد له عزما﴾: the wāw is resumptive; the lām is the answer to the omitted oath; (قد) is a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq); (عهدنا) is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); (إلى آدم) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿عهدنا﴾; (من قبل) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause ﴿ولقد عهدنا...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position; (فنسي) is conjoined to (عهد), i.e.: "he forgot what We had commanded him"; (ولم نجد): the wāw is a conjunction, (لم) is a particle of negation, inversion [of tense] and jussive, and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "we" (نحن); and (عزمًا) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

muyesser-irab:116-116.t: ﴿وإذ قلنا للملائكة اسجدوا لآدم فسجدوا إلا إبليس أبى﴾: the wāw is resumptive; ﴿إذ﴾ is a noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of the accusative as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, the implied sense being: "and remember when We said"; (قلنا) is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause ﴿قلنا﴾ is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); (للملائكة) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿قلنا﴾; (اسجدوا) is an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil, the verbal clause being in the position of the accusative as the content of the speech (maqūl al-qawl); (لآدم) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿اسجدوا﴾; (فسجدوا): the fāʾ is a conjunction, and (سجدوا) is a verb and its fāʿil; ﴿إلا﴾ is a particle of exception; (إبليس) is the excepted by ﴿إلا﴾, in a connected [exception] (muttaṣil) if Iblīs was originally one of the angels, and it is also said: disconnected (munqaṭiʿ), because he is not one of them; and (أبى) is a past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif, the verbal clause being in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e.: "while he was rejecting the command, being arrogant towards it and disbelieving in it".

muyesser-irab:117-117.t:
﴿فقلنا يا آدم إن هذا عدو لك ولزوجك﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; (قلنا) is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); (يا آدم) is a vocative; the clause (إن) is the content of the speech (maqūl al-qawl); (هذا) is the noun of inna, and (عدو) is its khabar (predicate); ﴿لك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of (عدو); and (ولزوجك) is conjoined to (لك).
﴿فلا يخرجنكما من الجنة فتشقى﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; (لا) is prohibitive; (يخرجنكما) is an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the jussive by (لا); the kāf is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the fāʿil is latent (mustatir), and it is Iblīs; the mīm and the alif are for the dual; (فتشقى): the fāʾ is the fāʾ of causation (al-sababiyya), and (تشقى) is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muḍmara) an after the fāʾ of causation, the fāʿil being latent, its implied form being "you" (أنت); the interpreted maṣdar from an and the verb is conjoined to a maṣdar extracted from the preceding speech, i.e.: "let there be no expulsion of you two from it, and so a misery for you".
.

muyesser-irab:118-118.t: ﴿إن لك ألا تجوع فيها ولا تعرى﴾: (إن) is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle; ﴿لك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate) of inna; (أن) together with what falls within its scope is its postponed noun (ism); (فيها) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿تجوع﴾; and (ولا تعرى) is conjoined to ﴿لا تجوع﴾.

muyesser-irab:119-119.t: ﴿وأنك لا تظمأ فيها ولا تضحى﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (أن) is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle, the kāf is its noun (ism), and the clause ﴿لا تظمأ فيها﴾ is its khabar (predicate); ﴿لا﴾ is negating; (تظمأ) is an imperfect verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); (فيها) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); and ﴿ولا تضحى﴾ is conjoined to ﴿لا تظمأ﴾.

muyesser-irab:120-120.t: ﴿فوسوس إليه الشيطان قال يا آدم هل أدلك على شجرة الخلد وملك لا يبلى﴾: (فوسوس): the fāʾ is a conjunction, and ﴿وسوس﴾ is a past verb; (إليه) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿وسوس﴾; (الشيطان) is the fāʿil (agent); ﴿قال يا آدم﴾ is a past verb and a vocative construction; (هل) is a particle of interrogation; (أدلك) is an imperfect verb, and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "I" (أنا), and the kāf is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿على شجرة الخلد﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿أدلك﴾; (ملك) is conjoined to (شجرة); and the clause (لا يبلى) is a naʿt (adjective) of (ملك).

muyesser-irab:121-121.t: ﴿فأكلا منها فبدت لهما سوآتهما وطفقا يخصفان عليهما من ورق الجنة وعصى آدم ربه فغوى﴾: (فأكلا) is a past verb, and the alif is the fāʿil (agent); (منها) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أكلا﴾; (فبدت) is conjoined to (أكلا); ﴿لهما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿بدت﴾; (سوءاتهما) is the fāʿil; (طفقا) is a past verb, one of the verbs of commencement (afʿāl al-shurūʿ), the alif being its noun (ism) and the clause (يخصفان) its khabar (predicate); ﴿عليهما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يخصفان﴾; and (من ورق الجنة) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of an omitted described noun, which is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), i.e.: "leaves from the leaves of the Garden". ﴿وعصى آدم ربه﴾ is a verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; and (فغوى) is conjoined to (عصى).

muyesser-irab:122-122.t: ﴿ثم اجتباه ربه فتاب عليه وهدى﴾: (ثم) is a conjunction; (اجتباه) is a verb and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (ربه) is the fāʿil (agent); (فتاب عليه) is conjoined to (اجتباه); and (هدى) is conjoined to (تاب).

muyesser-irab:123-123.t:
﴿قال اهبطا منها جميعا بعضكم لبعض عدو﴾: (اهبطا) is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the alif is the fāʿil (agent); (منها) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿اهبطا﴾; (جميعًا) is a ḥāl (circumstantial); (بعضكم) is a mubtadaʾ (subject); (لبعض) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl, because it was an adjective of (عدو); (عدو) is the khabar (predicate); and the clause ﴿بعضكم لبعض عدو﴾ is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl.
﴿فإما يأتينكم مني هدى فمن اتبع هداي فلا يضل ولا يشقى﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; (إن) is conditional, and (ما) is a connective (ṣila) particle; (يأتينكم) is an imperfect verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the kāf is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (مني) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يأتينكم﴾; (هدى) is the fāʿil of (يأتينكم); (فمن اتبع): the fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa), (من) is conditional, a mubtadaʾ, and (اتبع) is a past verb in the position of the jussive as the protasis; (هداي) is a mafʿūl bihi; the fāʾ connects the apodosis (jawāb); the clause ﴿لا يضل﴾ is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the protasis and its apodosis are the khabar of (من); and the clause ﴿من اتبع﴾ is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis of (إن).

muyesser-irab:124-124.t:
﴿ومن أعرض عن ذكري فإن له معيشة ضنكا﴾: the wāw conjoins to the preceding apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); ﴿مَن﴾ is a conditional noun that makes [the verb] jussive, a mubtadaʾ (subject); (أعرض) is a past verb in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and its fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "he" (هو); (عن ذكري) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أعرض﴾; (فإن): the fāʾ connects (rābiṭa) the apodosis, because it is a nominal clause; (إن) is an abrogating (nāsikh) particle; ﴿له﴾ is its fronted khabar (predicate); (معيشة) is its postponed noun (ism); (ضنكًا) is a naʿt (adjective); the nominal clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis; and the protasis and its apodosis are the khabar of (من).
﴿ونحشره يوم القيامة أعمى﴾: ﴿ونحشره﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; (نحشر) is an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ), the fāʿil being latent, its implied form being "we" (نحن), and the hāʾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (يوم القيامة) is an adverb attached to ﴿نحشره﴾; and (أعمى) is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the hāʾ in (نحشره).

muyesser-irab:125-125.t: ﴿قال رب لم حشرتني أعمى وقد كنت بصيرا﴾: (رب) is a vocative (munādā) annexed to the omitted yāʾ of the first person; ﴿لِمَ﴾: the lām is a preposition, and the interrogative (ما) is in the position of the genitive by the lām, the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿حشرتني﴾; (حشرتني) is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (أعمى) is a ḥāl (circumstantial); the wāw is circumstantial; (قد) is a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq); (كان) is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, the tāʾ being its noun (ism); and (بصيرًا) is the khabar (predicate) of kāna.

muyesser-irab:126-126.t: ﴿قال كذلك أتتك آياتنا فنسيتها وكذلك اليوم تنسى﴾: (قال) is a past verb; ﴿كذلك﴾: the kāf [Translator's note: the source repeats «الكاف» here] is a noun meaning "like", indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as an adjective of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e.: "they came to you with a coming like that coming", or in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e.: "the matter is thus"; ﴿ذلك﴾: ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the lām is for distance, and the kāf is a particle of address; ﴿أتتك آياتنا﴾ is a verb, a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and a postponed fāʿil (agent); (فنسيتها): the fāʾ is a conjunction, and ﴿نسيتها﴾ is a verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; ﴿كذلك﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like", indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as an adjective of an omitted maṣdar; ﴿ذلك﴾: ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi, the lām is for distance, and the kāf is a particle of address; and (اليوم) is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تنسى﴾.

muyesser-irab:127-127.t: ﴿وكذلك نجزي من أسرف ولم يؤمن بآيات ربه ولعذاب الآخرة أشد وأبقى﴾: ﴿كذلك﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like", indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as an adjective of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), the implied sense being: "with a recompense like that We recompense"; (ذلك): ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the lām is for distance, and the kāf is a particle of address; ﴿نجزي﴾ is an imperfect verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "we" (نحن); ﴿من﴾ is a relative noun, a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿أسرف﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿من﴾, with no grammatical position; ﴿ولم يؤمن﴾ is conjoined to (أسرف), so it falls within the scope of the ṣila; ﴿بآيات﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يؤمن﴾; ﴿ربه﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿ولعذاب﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya) or a conjunction, the lām is for inception (al-ibtidāʾ), and (عذاب) is a mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿الآخرة﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿أشد﴾ is the khabar (predicate); and ﴿وأبقى﴾ is conjoined to (أشد).

muyesser-irab:128-128.t:
﴿أفلم يهد لهم كم أهلكنا قبلهم من القرون يمشون في مساكنهم﴾: the hamza is for interrogation, and it introduces something omitted to which [the clause] is conjoined by the fāʾ, the implied sense being: "were they heedless, so that it did not become clear to them?"; the fāʿil (agent) of (يهد) is the maṣdar understood from (أهلكنا), i.e.: "has Our destroying not become clear to them?", or a pronoun referring back to Allah the Exalted, i.e.: "has Allah not made clear"; ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يهد﴾; (كم) is the predicative (khabariyya) kam, an object placed before (أهلكنا); (من القرون) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of the tamyīz (specification) of the predicative kam, i.e.: "how many a generation from among the generations"; the clause (يمشون في مساكنهم) is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the object of (أهلكنا), or from the pronoun in (لهم); (في مساكنهم) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يمشون﴾; and the pronoun refers back to those destroyed.
﴿إن في ذلك لآيات لأولي النهى﴾: (إن) and its fronted khabar (predicate); the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); (آيات) is its postponed noun (ism); (لأولي) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt of (آيات); and (النهى) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

muyesser-irab:129-129.t: ﴿ولولا كلمة سبقت من ربك لكان لزاما وأجل مسمى﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; (لولا) is a particle of non-occurrence due to occurrence (imtināʿ li-wujūd); (كلمة) is a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is omitted; the clause ﴿سبقت من ربك﴾ is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿كلمة﴾; (من ربك) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿سبقت﴾; ﴿لكان﴾: the lām occurs in the answer to (لولا), and (كان) is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, its noun (ism) being a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "it" (هو), referring back to the destruction; (لزامًا) is its khabar; and (أجل مسمى) is conjoined to (كلمة), or to the latent pronoun in ﴿كان﴾, i.e.: "the immediate destruction and an appointed term would have been binding on them, as they were binding on ʿĀd and Thamūd".

muyesser-irab:130-130.t: ﴿فاصبر على ما يقولون وسبح بحمد ربك قبل طلوع الشمس وقبل غروبها﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ implying an omitted condition); (اصبر) is an imperative verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); ﴿على ما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿اصبر﴾; the clause (يقولون) is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; (سبح) is conjoined to (اصبر); (بحمد ربك) is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e.: "while you are praising your Lord for having enabled you to glorify Him and having helped you in it"; (قبل) is an adverb attached to (سبح); (طلوع الشمس) is muḍāf [Translator's note: so in the source («مضاف»); (طلوع) is the muḍāf ilayhi of (قبل) and is itself annexed to (الشمس)]; and (وقبل غروبها) is conjoined to (قبل طلوع الشمس).

muyesser-irab:131-131.t:
﴿ولا تمدن عينيك إلى ما متعنا به أزواجا منهم زهرة الحياة الدنيا لنفتنهم فيه﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (لا) is prohibitive; (تمدن) is an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is joined to the nūn of emphasis, and it is in the position of the jussive by ﴿لا﴾, its fāʿil (agent) being a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "you" (أنت); (عينيك) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (إلى ما) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تمدن﴾; the clause (متعنا) is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿متعنا﴾, and the hāʾ is the referring pronoun (al-ʿāʾid); (أزواجًا) is the object of (متعنا); (منهم) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective), or it is accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun hāʾ; (منهم) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿متعنا﴾ [Translator's note: so in the source, which gives (منهم) a second, alternative attachment here]; and ﴿زهرة الحياة الدنيا﴾ has several views:
1 - a second object, if we parse ﴿أزواجًا﴾ as the first object, because the meaning of ﴿متعنا﴾ is "We gave".
2 - accusative as a ḥāl from the relative ﴿ما﴾.
3 - accusative as a badal (substitute) from ﴿أزواجًا﴾, by way of hyperbole.
4 - accusative by an implied verb indicated by ﴿متعنا﴾, its implied form being: "We made for them an adornment".
5 - accusative on account of blame (al-dhamm), i.e.: "I blame the adornment of the life of this world".
6 - accusative on account of specialisation (al-ikhtiṣāṣ).
7 - accusative as a badal from the position of ﴿به﴾.
8 - accusative as a ḥāl from the pronoun in ﴿به﴾.
9 - accusative as a tamyīz (specification) of ﴿ما﴾ or of the hāʾ in ﴿به﴾.
﴿لنفتنهم﴾: the lām is for causation (taʿlīl), and (نفتنهم) is an imperfect [verb], accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muḍmara) an after the lām of causation; the interpreted maṣdar from an and the verb is genitive (majrūr) by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿متعنا﴾; the hāʾ is a mafʿūl bihi; and (فيه) is attached to ﴿نفتنهم﴾.
﴿ورزق ربك خير وأبقى﴾: the wāw is circumstantial; (رزق) is a mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿ربك﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); ﴿خير﴾ is the khabar (predicate); and (أبقى) is conjoined to (خير).

muyesser-irab:132-132.t:
﴿وأمر أهلك بالصلاة واصطبر عليها لا نسألك رزقا﴾: the wāw is resumptive or a conjunction; the imperative verb is indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); (أهلك) is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (بالصلاة) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) the imperative verb; the clause ﴿وأمر أهلك بالصلاة﴾ is conjoined, or resumptive with no grammatical position; (اصطبر) is an imperative verb, and its fāʿil is latent, its implied form being "you" (أنت); (عليها) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿اصطبر﴾; the clause (لا نسألك) is resumptive; (نسألك) is an imperfect verb, a latent fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi; and (رزقًا) is a second mafʿūl bihi.
﴿نحن نرزقك والعاقبة للتقوى﴾: (نحن) is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause (نرزقك) is the khabar (predicate); (العاقبة) is a mubtadaʾ, and (للتقوى) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar; and these two clauses are also resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:133-133.t: ﴿وقالوا لولا يأتينا بآية من ربه أولم تأتهم بينة ما في الصحف الأولى﴾: (لولا) is a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ), i.e.: "why not?"; (يأتينا) is a verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (بآياته) [Translator's note: so in the source; the Quranic word is (بآية)] is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يأتينا﴾; (من ربه) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of (آية); (أولم): the hamza is for interrogation, and the wāw conjoins to something implied that the context requires, the implied sense being: "did not clear proofs come to them in succession, and did there not come to them, in particular, the clear proof of what is in the former scriptures?"; (بينة) is the fāʿil of ﴿تأتهم﴾; (ما) is a relative, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (في الصحف) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted [word] that is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position; and (الأولى) is a naʿt of (الصحف).

muyesser-irab:134-134.t:
﴿ولو أنا أهلكناهم بعذاب من قبله لقالوا ربنا لولا أرسلت إلينا رسولا﴾: ﴿لو﴾ is conditional; (أن) is an abrogating (nāsikh), maṣdar-forming particle, and ﴿نا﴾ is a pronoun in the position of the accusative as the noun of anna; (أهلكناهم) is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿أنّا﴾ together with what follows it is the fāʿil of an omitted verb, its implied form being "it were established" (ثبت), and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; (بعذاب) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أهلكناهم﴾; (من قبله) is a naʿt (adjective) of (عذاب); (لقالوا) is the answer to (لو), and the clause has no grammatical position; (ربنا) is a vocative (munādā) in a genitive construct, from which the vocative particle is omitted; (لولا) is a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ); (أرسلت) is a verb and its fāʿil; (إلينا) is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿أرسلت﴾; (رسولًا) is a mafʿūl bihi; and the clause is the content of the speech (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿فنتبع آياتك من قبل أن نذل ونخزى﴾: (فنتبع): the fāʾ is that of causation (al-sababiyya), and (نتبع) is accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muḍmara) an in answer to the urging; the interpreted maṣdar from an and the verb is conjoined to a maṣdar extracted from the preceding speech, i.e.: "why was there not a sending from You, and so a following from us?". The fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "we" (نحن); (آياتك) is a mafʿūl bihi, accusative with the kasra because it is a sound feminine plural; ﴿من قبل﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿نتبع﴾; (أن) together with what follows it is interpreted as a maṣdar that is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and ﴿نخزى﴾ is conjoined to ﴿نذل﴾.

muyesser-irab:135-135.t: ﴿قل كل متربص فتربصوا فستعلمون من أصحاب الصراط السوي ومن اهتدى﴾: (كل) is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and (متربص) is the khabar (predicate); the clause is the content of the speech (maqūl al-qawl); the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ implying an omitted condition); (تربصوا) is an imperative verb; (فستعلمون): the fāʾ is resumptive, the sīn is a particle of the future, and (تعلمون) is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, the wāw being the fāʿil (agent); ﴿مَن﴾ is an interrogative noun, a mubtadaʾ, and ﴿أصحاب الصراط السوي﴾ is the khabar; the clause ﴿فستعلمون مَن...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position; ﴿من اهتدى﴾ is conjoined to (من أصحاب); and the clause ﴿من أصحاب﴾ is the object of ﴿تعلمون﴾, which is suspended (muʿallaq) from operating; or ﴿من﴾ is a relative, the object of ﴿تعلمون﴾, and (أصحاب الصراط) is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e.: "they are the companions".
